llm.summary: The skill is a small, non-executable QiyueAstro card-reading integration, but it under-discloses sending user questions to remote services and contradicts itself about AI use.

dimensions.detail: Network access to QiyueAstro is coherent with the skill's purpose, but forwarding open-ended personal questions to a third-party API and AI endpoint is under-scoped for the disclosure provided.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only markdown documentation files; no executable scripts, package installers, local hooks, or hidden install behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions tell the agent to always pass a user's question to the external API when present and to display remote AI readings as-is, without requiring a privacy notice or explicit user control before transmission.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, credential access, privilege escalation, or background execution is present; the service does use IP-based quota/rate limiting, implying some remote request tracking outside the local environment.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main description and README frame the skill as card drawing and browsing with no AI use, while SKILL.md later adds a remote AI interpretation endpoint that can process user questions and return generated readings.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. This skill has no local code or credential access, but users should assume their Lenormand questions may be sent to QiyueAstro, including to a remote AI service for interpretation. Avoid entering sensitive personal, medical, financial, legal, or relationship details unless that third-party processing is acceptable.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in substance: the AI interpretation capability is related to readings, but it is not disclosed in the manifest-style description or README, which makes the capability summary materially incomplete.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: SKILL.md claims no AI compute is consumed, then documents a server-side AI interpretation endpoint, creating contradictory trust messaging.
[SQP-2] expected: Partially accepted: passing a question to a draw endpoint is coherent for a personalized reading, but the artifact does not warn that the question is transmitted to QiyueAstro.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted: the AI interpretation endpoint sends the user's prompt to a remote service for generated output, and the artifact lacks clear consent or privacy guidance before use.
